description: Context-layer checklist for PR DEM reviewed candidate follow-up packets. Items are review prompts, not confirmations.

checklist.label: DEM hillshade
checklist.question: Does hillshade support the candidate geometry, or does it suggest a raster/seam artifact?

checklist.label: Slope raster
checklist.question: Is the candidate internally flat relative to the surrounding terrain?

checklist.label: Recent imagery basemap
checklist.question: Is there a visible clearing, structure, pad, vegetation obstruction, or no clear signal?

checklist.label: Historical imagery
checklist.question: Does the feature appear, disappear, expand, or remain stable across time?

checklist.label: Roads / TIGER edges
checklist.question: Is there road, dead-end, track, or service access near the candidate?

checklist.label: Hydro / water assets
checklist.question: Is the candidate near stream, drainage, reservoir, dam, canal, pumping, or water-utility context?

checklist.label: Power / utility layers
checklist.question: Is the candidate near a powerline, substation, tower-like site, pipeline, or utility corridor?

checklist.label: Karst / geology
checklist.question: Is the candidate inside karst, near a karst boundary, or near a closed-depression context?

checklist.label: Parcel / ownership layer if available
checklist.question: Does parcel/ownership context explain the feature as ordinary land use or require further review?

checklist.label: False-positive check
checklist.question: Could this be a quarry, road cut, pasture, agricultural pad, building pad, natural summit, or data artifact?
